scope: Offline portable HTML rendered in Chromium via Playwright set_content. Mobile is viewport emulation, not a physical phone. Media error was injected as a DOM event. No live deployment/network, Safari/iOS, no-JavaScript browser run, hardware FPS or Lighthouse verification.
